title: How to spot a fake natty: inability to explain muscle size
summary: A simple fake-natty test: naturals remember the long, painstaking work behind each muscle, so someone who can't explain how they built upper chest, traps, shoulders or upper back ('they just grow') is likely enhanced. Such people have nothing to teach, and young lifters with 18-inch arms out of nowhere are a dead giveaway.

claims.claim: Even genetically gifted naturals usually have only one or two muscles that grow without much work; everything else requires memorable, painstaking accumulation of sets, reps and volume.
An easy way to spot an enhanced lifter lying about it is that they can't explain how they built their muscle size.
The most suspicious muscles are the upper chest, traps, shoulders and upper back, which naturals only develop with extreme genetics or a ton of work.
Answers like 'I just do pulls' or 'they just grow' to how someone got huge traps are a dead giveaway; natural muscles don't just grow.
He can explain how every one of his body parts grew and which exercises built them; none just grew, even the gifted ones.
There's nothing to learn from fake natties: they can't teach how they got big because the recipe is what they take, not training.
Lifters who got big from drugs without the knowledge will lose that muscle when they stop, because they never knew how to build it.
He has trained arms passionately for almost a decade and could talk about arm training for 30 minutes; behind a physique there should be shareable knowledge for the community.
Shoulders, traps and upper chest are giveaways because they have many androgen receptors and blow up on drugs with little work.
Arms are different: limb length can make arms look big without big measurements, though arms also respond strongly to an enhanced hormonal environment.
The naturals he has met with big arms were older men who'd been training a long time; big arms are an old man's game, while quads can grow fast with good genetics.
A young kid with 18-inch arms out of nowhere who says he just curls 20 lbs is a dead giveaway.
